name: Una Rosa Rosada Para Rosa
source:
A truly captivating tale featuring a beautiful young girl named Rosa, as she struggles to find true love.
Play as Gregorio, a man who is deeply enamored with Rosa. Fight along side him for Rosa's affections, and honor. 
It will take everything Gregorio has to keep his darling until the end of their engagement party.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=7792]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
这是一个引人入胜的故事，讲述美丽的少女罗莎努力寻找真爱的经历。
你将扮演格雷戈里奥，一位深深爱着罗莎的男人。与他并肩，为罗莎的爱和荣誉而战。
为了守护心爱之人，直到订婚宴结束，格雷戈里奥必须竭尽全力。

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=7792]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
